name: Nebraska

jury_list.holder: Jury commissioner of each county (Jury Selection Act, Neb. Rev. Stat. 25-1625 et seq.).

sources.cite: Neb. Rev. Stat. 25-1650 (jurors must be U.S. citizens; disability documents are not public records)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person who gives name, address, phone, email, organization, and reason, and signs an oath (Neb. Rev. Stat. 32-330(2), (4)).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Solely for purposes related to elections, political activities, voter registration, law enforcement, or jury selection. Not to be posted, displayed, used commercially, or made accessible on the Internet (32-330(2)).
voter_file.use_restriction: Neb. Rev. Stat. 32-330(2): 'Lists shall be used solely for purposes related to elections, political activities, voter registration, law enforcement, or jury selection. Lists shall not be posted, displayed, or used for commercial purposes or made accessible on the Internet.'
voter_file.penalty: The oath is sworn under penalty of election falsification, a Class IV felony (32-330(4)).
voter_file.attestation_required: Sworn oath to use the list only for 32-330 purposes, not to permit unauthorized use or copying, and not to post it on the Internet (32-330(4)).

private_challenge.who: At the polls only: an inspector, judge or clerk of election, or registered voter may challenge a person offering to vote (Neb. Rev. Stat. 32-926). A person challenged as an alien must show naturalization papers or complete a form (32-928). No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Neb. Rev. Stat. 32-926 to 32-932. Not supported by JuryRoll.

county_board.name: Nebraska election officials contact information (Secretary of State)

gates.basis: Jury disqualification records: status unknown (null), so counts only. Challenges exist only at the polls. The voter list may be used only for listed purposes, under oath (32-330).

notes: Use limit: the 32-330 oath limits use to election, political, voter registration, law enforcement, or jury selection purposes, under penalty of a Class IV felony. The app should warn Nebraska users and show the 32-330 text before they load a voter file.
The public voter list shows birth year only (32-330(3)(b)(vii)), so dob_in_public_file is false. Date of registration is included ((3)(b)(viii)).
official_pipeline is null: no jury-to-election-official non-citizen statute was found in the Jury Selection Act sections read (25-1649 to 25-1660).
